verdict.rationale: Proa components are written in typed Rust. A template macro is validated at compile time and handles dynamic slots, and one typed component can render HTML and Markdown, so markup and rendering logic live together in one Rust component. Styles are only shown as separate stylesheet files with hot reload, not as part of the component, and a developer must already know Rust. Missing for 10: documented co-location of styles within a component, full examples of the template syntax, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write markup and rendering logic together in a single component using markup, styles, and a language I already know

citations.quote: Source in your repo, in typed Rust. Theme it, compose it, ship it.
The macro validates the template at compile time, consolidates adjacent static markup, and preserves the correct escaping behavior for dynamic slots.
HTML, Markdown, and other render targets, from one typed component.
